environment: Node v24.19.0, Python 3.14.7, git 2.50.1; scratch worktree of sdlc/S-006; no network

cases.title: name lowercases only the tail under {name:lower}
cases.given: formats feature/PROJ-1-{name:lower}, Feat/PROJ-{name:lower}-X, FEAT/{name:lower}, mixed-case and unicode parts
cases.when: name and tail are called; 3000 generated cases are compared with a reference model written from the spec
cases.then: prefix and suffix keep their case; the middle is the lowercased tail; {name} keeps the tail case

evidence.title: name vs reference model
evidence.inline:
property name-vs-model: seed=20261010 runs=3000 violations=0
checks: equals model, deterministic, parts not mutated, no stdout, affixes unchanged, lower flag, middle == tail (lowercased when asked)

cases.title: Spec examples run verbatim
cases.given: the R-011 acceptance example and the table samples
cases.then: the branch equals the spec string

evidence.title: examples
evidence.inline: feature/PROJ-1-s-001, feature/PROJ-1-S-001, Feat/PROJ-s-001-X, FEAT/m-1-e2e-api, sdlc/M-1-e2e-api, sdlc/M-1-e2e, sdlc/S-001-v0-http-api-0 all match

cases.title: Every kind under three formats builds a valid branch that split reverses
cases.given: 8 kinds x 3 formats with the spec sample parts, including area api-v2, state ts and verify round 0 part 0
cases.when: name builds the branch, split strips the prefix and suffix, git check-ref-format --branch runs
cases.then: the middle equals the tail (lowercased when asked); git accepts every branch

evidence.title: generated round trip
evidence.inline: 3000 generated cases over 8 kinds, 6 prefixes, 5 suffixes, unicode ids (İ, ß, ǅ, Σ, CJK, emoji): 0 violations, seed 20261010

cases.title: Scanner semantics: sites, windows, comments, limits
cases.given: strings with pushes, pr create, wrapped pushes, comments, a variable-built branch
cases.when: the scanner function is extracted from branches.test.mjs and run
cases.then: it reports e2e-area pushes within the 4-line window, skips comments, finds a site in an empty-violation file
cases.expected: planted push 1 violation; plain e2e 0; comment 0
cases.actual: as expected; limits confirmed: variable-built branch, list-form pr create and e2e-area more than 3 lines after the push line pass unseen

cases.title: Mutation: planted e2e-area push in a scratch state-write.py fails T-R-120a; dropped lower fails T-R-011a and T-R-068a
cases.given: a scratch copy of skills with one planted defect each
cases.when: node --test runs the real tests in the copy
cases.then: each run exits non-zero; the clean copy exits 0
cases.actual: e2e-area push exit 1; drop lower exit 1; lower whole branch exit 1; lower prefix exit 1; clean exit 0

evidence.title: mutations
evidence.inline:
mutation e2e-area push in state-write.py: exit 1
mutation drop lower: exit 1
mutation lower whole branch: exit 1
mutation lower prefix only: exit 1

cases.title: Surface and dependencies
cases.when: the public functions and imports are listed
cases.then: name, tail, split keep their shape; only stdlib imports

seeds.title: R-120 scan misses list-form gh pr create
seeds.detail: PUSH_SITE matches the text 'pr create'. A call such as run(repo, 'gh', 'pr', 'create', '--head', x) has no such text, so it is not a site. Match the quoted 'create' after 'pr' too.

seeds.title: R-120 scan reads only the kind name and six files
seeds.detail: A variable-built branch, an e2e-area name more than 3 lines after the push line, and the prompts under skills/sdlc/prompts are not scanned. S-009 and S-021 to S-024 must tighten it to the parsed kind.
